title: Co-Ordinate
summary: CO-ORDINATE, adjective [Latin , to regulate. See Order.] Being of equal order, or of the same rank or degree; not subordinate; as, two courts of co-ordinate jurisdiction.

inlines.v: CO-ORDINATE, adjective [Latin , to regulate. See Order.] Being of equal order, or of the same rank or degree; not subordinate; as, two courts of co-ordinate jurisdiction.
